user_query: trass gmail with term mgm from last 30 days

intent.goal: find emails containing 'mgm' in trass gmail

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE (
    u.workspace = 'trass' AND
    u.database_name = 'gmail' AND
    (
        g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        g.sender_name LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
    ) AND
    g.email_date >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
)
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 5000;
